identificationModule.officialTitle: An Immunogenicity and Safety Study of Gardasil (V501 (Human Papillomavirus [Types 6, 11, 16, 18] Recombinant Vaccine)) in Females 9 to 23 Years of Age in Korea

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an immunogenicity and safety study of Gardasil (V501) in females 9 to 23 years of age in Korea.

interventions.name: Gardasil™
interventions.description: Gardasil™ 3 dose regimen (Day 1, Month 2 and Month 6)

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Gardasil™ matching placebo 3 dose regimen (Day 1, Month 2 and Month 6)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Who Seroconvert to HPV 6.
primaryOutcomes.description: Vaccine-induced anti-HPV 6 seroconversion following administration of a 3-dose regimen of GARDASIL® in females 9 to 23 years of age in Korea. Seroconversion for HPV 6 was defined as achieving an anti-HPV cLIA (Competitive Luminex immunoassay) level of at least 20 mMU/mL.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Who Seroconvert to HPV 11.
primaryOutcomes.description: Vaccine-induced anti-HPV 11 seroconversion following administration of a 3-dose regimen of GARDASIL® in females 9 to 23 years of age in Korea. Seroconversion for HPV 11 was defined as achieving an anti-HPV cLIA (Competitive Luminex immunoassay) level of at least 16 mMU/mL.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Who Seroconvert to HPV 16.
primaryOutcomes.description: Vaccine-induced anti-HPV 16 seroconversion following administration of a 3-dose regimen of GARDASIL® in females 9 to 23 years of age in Korea. Seroconversion for HPV 16 was defined as achieving an anti-HPV cLIA (Competitive Luminex immunoassay) level of at least 20 mMU/mL.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Who Seroconvert to HPV 18.
primaryOutcomes.description: Vaccine-induced anti-HPV 18 seroconversion following administration of a 3-dose regimen of GARDASIL® in females 9 to 23 years of age in Korea. Seroconversion for HPV 18 was defined as achieving an anti-HPV cLIA (Competitive Luminex immunoassay) level of at least 24 mMU/mL.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With Adverse Experiences
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants who reported 1 or more adverse experience.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Overall study including 14 calendar days after the last vaccination visit.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Girls ages 9 to 15 years (must not yet have had coitarche)
* Healthy females ages 16 to 23 years (individuals with a lifetime history of 0 to 3 male or female sexual partners)

Exclusion Criteria:

All Subjects:

* History of known prior vaccination with an HPV vaccine.

Women Ages 16 to 23 Only:

* Individuals with any prior history of genital warts or treatment for genital warts.
* Individuals with \> 3 lifetime male or female sexual partners.
